effect.en: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage.  Makes the user switch out.

flavor.ko: 막말을 내뱉어 상대를 위협하여 공격과 특수공격을 떨어뜨린 후 교대 포켓몬과 교체한다.
flavor.en: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
